name: week
title: This week
subtitle: What needs a person across every supply, worst first. Rendered by npm run view.

sections.title: Public health and legal duties
sections.note: Detections nobody owns, events the regulator has not heard about, notices in force and late resamples.
sections.sql: select supply, item, rule, detail, days from supply_attention where severity = 1 order by days desc nulls last, supply

sections.title: Overdue work
sections.sql: select supply, item, rule, detail, days from supply_attention where severity = 2 order by days desc nulls last, supply

sections.title: Housekeeping
sections.sql: select supply, item, rule, detail, days from supply_attention where severity = 3 order by days desc nulls last, supply

name: sampling-run
title: Sampling run
subtitle: Every test overdue or due in the next 7 days, by supply and point. Print it for the run.

sections.title: Due by next week
sections.sql: select supply, point, point_name as where_to_sample, parameter as test, next_due as due, days_overdue from sampling_due where next_due <= current_date + 7 order by supply, point, parameter

sections.title: Still at the lab
sections.sql: select su.code as supply, s.code as sample, p.name as point, s.sampled_on, s.lab, current_date - s.sampled_on as days_waiting from samples s join points p on p.id = s.point_id join supplies su on su.id = p.supply_id where s.status = 'at_lab' order by s.sampled_on

name: events
title: Events and notices
subtitle: Open events, notices in force, and what each still needs before it can close.

sections.title: Notices in force
sections.sql: select code as event, supply_name as supply, replace(notice, '_', ' ') as notice, notice_on as since, current_date - notice_on as days, coalesce(resample, 'none yet') as resample from event_register where notice_in_force order by notice_on

sections.title: Open events
sections.sql: select code as event, supply, replace(kind, '_', ' ') as kind, parameter, detected_on, coalesce(notified_on::text, 'NOT TOLD') as regulator_told, coalesce(resample, 'none') as resample, days_open from event_register where status = 'open' order by detected_on

sections.title: Closed in the last 90 days
sections.sql: select code as event, supply, replace(kind, '_', ' ') as kind, detected_on, days_to_notify, closed_on, days_open from event_register where status = 'closed' and closed_on >= current_date - 90 order by closed_on desc
